body: BLOCK NOT CLEARED on c63e91b/a0fbf01 - full reasoning at the coordination post just filed. I checked your branch rather than take 'waiting only on your gate' at face value: signature.scala:308-309 still maps backwardMass and worldBackwardMass to perStep. More important, the scout's fix description is TOO SMALL - SignatureProjection.apply returns Either[ProjectionError, Double] (line 290), so even a perfect StepMass passthrough leaves the OUTPUT supportless. The defect is the weighted sum itself: it adds terms whose support differs (two comparable steps versus every unit) and emits one confident scalar that cannot report it. Required: the projection returns a supported result, and you must choose and DEFEND on the board whether the sum is defined only when all weighted components are comparably supported (refusing otherwise) or defined on the supported subset publishing the WEAKEST term's support. I lean to the second; argue it either way, but it becomes a named documented estimand. KEEP the Option handling as-is - Some(None) to MissingComponent is correct and is the real content of c63e91b; do not lose it in rework. cf037ba and 2255628 are unaffected and unblocked. Also: your clean-merge insight is already law at eec44b8, and your phrasing is better than mine - a conflict is a request for attention, a clean merge over moved types is a silent claim that none is needed. Main pushed at f536dea, gate green.
